string-array.name: municipalities_array
string-array.item: Beijing is the capital of the People\'s Republic of China and one of its four direct-administered municipalities. With a history of more than 3,000 years, it served as the imperial capital of the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties for over 800 years. The city is famous for the Forbidden City, the Great Wall at Badaling, the Temple of Heaven and the Summer Palace. Today Beijing is the nation\'s political, cultural and diplomatic centre and a global city, having hosted both the 2008 Summer Olympics and the 2022 Winter Olympics.

Shanghai is China\'s largest city and a global financial and trade centre. Located on the coast of the East China Sea at the mouth of the Yangtze River, it grew from a small fishing town into a booming international port. The Bund displays historic colonial architecture, while Pudong\'s skyline, with the Oriental Pearl Tower and Shanghai Tower, symbolises modern China. Today Shanghai is the busiest container port in the world and a leading centre of finance, technology and culture.

Tianjin is one of China\'s four direct-administered municipalities, located in the north on the Bohai Sea. With a history of over 600 years, it developed as the main seaport and gateway to the capital Beijing. In the late Qing dynasty it became a treaty port, leaving behind an Italian-style town and Western-style buildings. Today Tianjin is a major industrial, commercial and logistics centre, famous for the Tianjin Eye ferris wheel over the Hai River and its traditional snacks.

Chongqing is one of China\'s four municipalities, located in the southwest at the meeting point of the Yangtze and Jialing Rivers. With about 3,000 years of history, it was the temporary capital of China during the Second World War. Surrounded by mountains and crossed by rivers, it is known as the Mountain City and is famous for hotpot. Chongqing became a municipality directly under the central government in 1997 and is now an important industrial, manufacturing and transport hub in inland China.
